meta.name: publish
meta.description: Publish oh-my-opencode to npm by triggering the GitHub Actions publish workflow and verifying its artifacts. Ship-only: never runs pre-publish-review or re-reviews merged code unless the user explicitly asks. Argument: <patch|minor|major|explicit-semver>. Triggers: publish, release, deploy, npm publish.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把新版本发布到 npm 并确认发布成功
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果发布了新版本后需要确认它真正上线了
copy.tagline_en: Publish a new version to npm and confirm the release succeeded
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ship a new version and verify it went live

howto.what: 收到发布请求后,Claude 会触发 GitHub Actions 的 publish 工作流,跑完并核验 npm 包、GitHub Release、Discord 公告等发布产出,全部确认后才结束;不会顺手做代码审阅或修 bug。
howto.when: 当你下达 publish、release、deploy 等发布指令,并给出 patch、minor、major 或明确版本号时触发;如果没给版本档位,它会先停下询问。

say.text: 用 patch 版本把 oh-my-opencode 发到 npm。
say.note: 会触发发布流程并生成补丁版摘要。

say.text: 按 minor 发布,发完在 Discord 发公告。
say.note: 会走完整发布流程并核验各平台产物。
把这个明确版本号作为本次发布版本。

howto.what_en: When asked to publish, Claude triggers the GitHub Actions publish workflow, drafts the release summary while waiting, then verifies npm versions, GitHub release, and Discord announcement before finishing. It does not review or fix code.
howto.when_en: Triggers on publish/release/deploy-style requests with a release selector (patch, minor, major, or explicit semver). If no selector is given, Claude stops and asks for one.

say_en.text: Publish oh-my-opencode to npm as a patch release.
say_en.note: Kicks off the publish workflow with a patch summary.

say_en.text: Do a minor release, then post the announcement to Discord.
say_en.note: Runs the full publish workflow end to end.
Uses explicit semver as the release version.
